---
title: Productive workflows in Positron
---

## Overview

Pick up Positron- and Quarto-specific productivity tips, including editor settings worth adopting, auto-formatting with Air, and practical ways to incorporate LLMs into your Quarto workflow.

{{< include _slides.md >}}

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, you will be able to:

* Use Positron's Quarto-specific features to author and preview documents more efficiently.
* Auto-format R code in Quarto documents with Air.
* Incorporate LLM assistance into a Quarto workflow in practical, deliberate ways.
